blocks.text: The preposition **по** means "along" and is used with the dative case: *Я иду по коридору. Они едут по дороге.* **По** may mean "about", "around": *Он ходит по комнате. Они ездят по городу.* Notice also: **по почте** — by mail; **по телефону** — by phone; **по радио** — by radio; **по делу** — on business.

items: **Motion on/along/across a surface** - the most common meaning is movement across (e.g., crossing the road), or along (e.g., walking along the street), or about (i.e., moving all around the entirety of a surface), or otherwise moving in some fashion on top of some surface.
Работа по дому - notice that 'across a surface' can be interpreted quite loosely, and can lead to idioms such as this.
**Activity in identical places/times** - some activity or verb is occurring in multiple instances of a place or time. Places visited multiple times, or things done at multiple times, use **по**.
She went around to many shops

**Uniform distribution** - commonly translated as 'apiece' or 'per', this use of **по** is used to denote a singular noun as being distributed one apiece. For example, in the sentence, 'He gave his boys one apple each', we could say **по яблоку** to mean 'one apple each'. If there are multiple objects being given out, (e.g., 'five apples each'), use **по** and the *accusative* case.
Он дал его детям по яблоку - one item each, so по + dat; note that the dative is also used for 'his kids'.
He gave his boys one apple each
Он дал его детям по два яблока - two items each, so по + acc.
He gave his boys two apples each
**The thing struck** - primarily used with the verb **бить/побить** ('to beat/strike'), this denotes something as being struck or hit or beat.
He hit the table with his shoe
**Reason or cause of** - the reason or cause of some event can be denoted using **по** and the dative case.
The woman drank the poison by mistake
**Your specialization** - the trade or subject you specialize in, particularly with work, school, exams, etc. This typically translates as 'in'.
**In accordance with** - this usage denotes one thing as being in line with, or in accord with, or in accordance with, another thing, such as a plane flying to schedule.
The plane flew according to plan

blocks.text: **По** can also be used with the accusative case (meaning 'up to' or 'till', or, as discussed above, 'apiece'), and with the prepositional case (meaning 'after' or 'for'). **К** is relatively simpler, referring to or gesturing at the direction something is located.

Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.
Further sentences, so that every pattern above is practised: from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English.

exercises.why: **телефон → телефону** (dat. sg.). Declines like дом. Ending — (no ending) → -у.

exercises.prompt: Thank God I am an atheist.
exercises.why: **бог → богу** (dat. sg.). Declines like студент. Ending — (no ending) → -у.

exercises.prompt: Defying the prognosis, the patient survived.
exercises.why: **прогноз → прогнозам** (dat. pl.). Declines like стол. Ending — (no ending) → -ам.

exercises.prompt: Everything is going according to plan.
exercises.why: **план → плану** (dat. sg.). Declines like дом. Ending — (no ending) → -у.
**ветер → ветру** (dat. sg.). Declines like дом. Ending — (no ending) → -у, with the fleeting -е- of the stem dropped: ветр- + -у.

exercises.q: Не суди о книге по ___ (обложка, dat. sg.).
exercises.prompt: Don't judge a book by its cover.
exercises.why: **обложка → обложке** (dat. sg.). Declines like газета. Ending -а → -е.

exercises.q: Велосипед едет благодаря ___ (нажатие, dat. sg.) на педали.
exercises.prompt: By pushing on the pedals, you make the bike go.
exercises.why: **нажатие → нажатию** (dat. sg.). Declines like здание. Ending -е → -ю.

exercises.q: Согласно ___ (стоматолог, dat. pl.), кариес зубов не всегда вызывается только сладостями.
exercises.prompt: According to dentists, tooth decay is not always caused by sweets.
exercises.why: **стоматолог → стоматологам** (dat. pl.). Declines like студент. Ending — (no ending) → -ам.

exercises.q: Земная магнитосфера создаётся благодаря ___ (постоянное движение, dat. sg.) расплавленного металла внутри Земли.
exercises.prompt: Earth’s magnetosphere is created by the constantly moving molten metal inside Earth.
exercises.why: **движение → движению** (dat. sg.). Declines like здание. Ending -е → -ю.  **постоянный → постоянному** (dat. sg. n., agreeing with движению). Declines like новый. Ending -ое → -ому.

exercises.q: Согласно ___ (миф, dat. pl.), Троянская война началась с ссоры трёх богинь.
exercises.prompt: According to myths, the Trojan War began with a quarrel between three goddesses.
exercises.why: **миф → мифам** (dat. pl.). Declines like стол. Ending — (no ending) → -ам.

exercises.q: Книги по ___ (самопомощь, dat. sg.) помогают только людям, которые их продают.
exercises.prompt: Self-help books only help the people who sell them.
exercises.why: **самопомощь → самопомощи** (dat. sg.). Declines like часть. Ending -ь → -и.

exercises.q: Своё название броненосец получил благодаря ___ (броня, dat. sg.), которая покрывает его спину.
exercises.prompt: It acquired the name "armadillo" thanks to the armor that covers its back.
exercises.why: **броня → броне** (dat. sg.). Declines like неделя. Ending -я → -е.

exercises.q: Согласно ___ (наш уговор, dat. sg.), вы должны уплатить половину.
exercises.prompt: According to our bargain, you have to pay half.
exercises.why: **уговор → уговору** (dat. sg.). Declines like дом. Ending — (no ending) → -у.  **наш → нашему** (dat. sg. m., agreeing with уговору). Declines like наш. Ending — (no ending) → -ему.

exercises.q: Вопреки ___ (распространённый, dat. sg. n.) мнению, это не опасно.
exercises.prompt: Contrary to popular belief, it isn't dangerous.
exercises.why: **распространённый → распространённому** (dat. sg. n., agreeing with мнению). Declines like новый. Ending -ое → -ому.

exercises.q: Том сделал это вопреки ___ (свой, dat. sg. f.) воле.
exercises.prompt: Tom did it against his will.
exercises.why: **свой → своей** (dat. sg. f., agreeing with воле). Declines like мой. Ending -я → -ей.

exercises.q: Можем ли мы найти радость вопреки ___ (страдание, dat. sg.) и смерти?
exercises.prompt: Can we find joy in spite of suffering and death?
exercises.why: **страдание → страданию** (dat. sg.). Declines like здание. Ending -е → -ю.

exercises.q: Я безмятежно делаю свой первый шаг навстречу ___ (вечность, dat. sg.) и ухожу из жизни, чтобы войти в историю.
exercises.prompt: Serenely I take my first step towards eternity and leave life to enter history.
exercises.why: **вечность → вечности** (dat. sg.). Declines like часть. Ending -ь → -и.
